append.detail: Per-segment custom contact fields, light JSON as ruled: space_segments.field_keys (migration 20270346001900) names custom_field_registry keys in order. The Space CRM Import view has Fields by segment (tick fields per segment, add a field by hand); a contact card shows the template fields of every segment it is in (membership by resolveAudience, the send resolver) and an editor saves them into contacts.meta.custom, editor-gated, Space-bound and typed by the registry. CSV import already maps columns to the same keys. Custom objects stay ruled out.
